$comment: English texts of data/camp.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the camp's own level, the Cornerstone with the Builder Spirit, and the System Collector. The Stronghold (fortress) comes in a later stage.
name: Camp
description: A clearing at the edge of the wilds that will in time become a stronghold. Each camp level speeds up the construction of every building.
evolution: Once the Camp and all its buildings reach their highest level, the Camp will be able to become a Stronghold.

cornerstone.name: Stronghold Cornerstone
cornerstone.label: Cornerstone
cornerstone.text: A large stone with a carved sign. The Stronghold will stand here once the Camp and all its buildings reach their highest level.
cornerstone.ready: The Camp is ready. The change into a Stronghold will begin here once it comes to the game.

spirit.name: Builder Spirit
spirit.line: I will buy your surplus wood, stone and ore for gold.

texts.need: The Camp's builds still need {count} more.
texts.least: For fewer than {count} the spirit pays nothing.
texts.unknown: The Builder Spirit buys only wood, stone and iron ore.
texts.notEnough: You do not have that many.
texts.locked: The Builder Spirit will appear in the Camp along with the Settlement.

texts.offer: Collects resources from the Camp's full stores for you, so nothing is lost even during a long absence.
texts.bought: The System Collector will now look after the Camp's stores.
texts.hint: The System Collector will collect the resources when the store fills up.
texts.owned: You already have the System Collector.
texts.noGold: Not enough gold for the System Collector.
